definitions.explanation: In anatomy and medicine, the thin layer of cells lining the inside of blood vessels, the heart, and other hollow organs. Contrasted with {外皮|がいひ} (outer skin) and {中皮|ちゅうひ} (mesothelium).

definitions.gloss: inner rind; inner skin (of fruit, seeds, etc.)
definitions.explanation: In botany and cooking, the thin white or translucent membrane found just inside the outer peel of citrus fruits, chestnuts, and similar foods. Often removed for a better texture or flavor.

examples.japanese: {内皮|ないひ}{細胞|さいぼう}が{傷|きず}つく。
{高血圧|こうけつあつ}は{血管|けっかん}の{内皮|ないひ}に{悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: High blood pressure has a negative impact on the endothelium of blood vessels.

examples.japanese: {栗|くり}の{内皮|ないひ}を{剥|む}く。
examples.english: Peel the inner skin of the chestnut.

examples.japanese: {みかん}の{内皮|ないひ}には{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{多|おお}く{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The inner skin of a mandarin orange contains a lot of dietary fiber.

examples.japanese: {料理人|りょうりにん}は{丁寧|ていねい}に{栗|くり}の{内皮|ないひ}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いてから{煮|に}る。
examples.english: The chef carefully removes the inner skin of the chestnuts before simmering them.

notes:
Composed of {内|ない} (inner) and {皮|ひ} (skin). A technical compound with parallel counterparts in {外皮|がいひ} (outer skin), {中皮|ちゅうひ} (mesothelium), and {表皮|ひょうひ} (epidermis).

USAGE:
The anatomical sense (sense 1) is the most common in writing — it appears in medical journals, health articles, and biology textbooks, often in combinations like {血管|けっかん}{内皮|ないひ} (vascular endothelium) or {内皮|ないひ}{細胞|さいぼう} (endothelial cells). The culinary/botanical sense (sense 2) appears in cooking instructions and describes the thin inner membrane that must be removed from chestnuts, citrus fruits, and similar foods. Context makes clear which sense is intended.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血管|けっかん}{内皮|ないひ}: vascular endothelium
- {内皮|ないひ}{細胞|さいぼう}: endothelial cells
- {内皮|ないひ}{機能|きのう}: endothelial function
- {内皮|ないひ}を{剥|む}く: to peel off the inner skin (of a fruit)
- {栗|くり}の{内皮|ないひ}: the inner skin of a chestnut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外皮|がいひ}: outer skin; peel — the direct antonym
- {表皮|ひょうひ}: epidermis — the outermost layer, especially of human skin
- {中皮|ちゅうひ}: mesothelium — the cell layer lining body cavities
- {渋皮|しぶかわ}: the astringent inner skin (specifically of chestnuts) — more specific culinary term
